item.title: A Course Called Ireland: Bill Murray clearly hated making his new golfing show – but it’s extremely fun to binge
item.description: In his rogue new travelogue, the Hollywood star tees off, has drunken pub singalongs – but mostly just proves how tired he is of fame I’m suspicious of travelogues, which often feature celebrities in contrived situations, serving up a sentimental postcard of a place that is tantamount to a lie. I also hate how famous people are inexorably drawn to golf: a boring game historically predicated on a rancid mix of social exclusivity and extensive land ownership. So it was perverse of me to watch a show in which author Tom Coyne drives around Ireland playing various courses with his friend, actor… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Artist Mark Cline built a foam Stonehenge replica in 2004; it later moved to a Virginia farm
item.description: In 2004, Mark Cline constructed Foamhenge, a whimsical replica of Stonehenge, to entice tourists. After more than a decade in Natural Bridge, Virginia, it needed to relocate in 2016 due to park land developments. item.description: Shepherd’s Bush Empire, London Richly wrought lyrical wit and sumptuous harmonies enhance the duo’s clever new show – along with plenty of backchat The last time Flo & Joan played Shepherd’s Bush Empire, they found a setlist on stage left by beloved indie-rock band the Feeling on the previous night. It made the sisters contemplate their own relationship to the music industry. Are Flo & Joan a proper band or doomed for ever to remain “musical comedy”? The problem with which, they deadpan here, is that “no one takes it seriously”. Cue this new show, its structure inspired by that chance… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Super Graphic Spectacular review – Chappell Roan dazzles at her gloriously gay mini-festival
item.description: Shrine Auditorium, Los Angeles With performances by Christina Aguilera, Lola Young and Tinashe, the pop star brings a colorful vision to life in support of LGBTQ+ charities At Chappell Roan ’s Super Graphic Spectacular, the sincerely camp pop star imagines a world where the most vulnerable among us aren’t wielded as scapegoats, and where life can be good, so long as we are good to one another. That better world takes the form of a two-night extravaganza at Los Angeles’s Shrine Auditorium, part kiki ball, part fabulous revue, celebrating the first anniversary of the Midwest Princess Project… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Jorge Drexler explora la identidad uruguaya y la memoria en su nuevo álbum, 'Taracá'
item.description: Con Taracá, su decimoquinto álbum de estudio, el cantautor uruguayo Jorge Drexler regresa a los sonidos de su país para explorar nuevas formas de diálogo musical. Entre los tambores del candombe, las tradiciones afro-uruguayas y colaboraciones con artistas de distintas generaciones. En Carrusel de las Artes, Drexler comparte detalles sobre esta reflexión sobre el presente, la memoria y la intolerancia en América Latina. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: EMPRENDEDORES | MAYTE, TALENTO JOVEN CON IDENTIDAD TARIJEÑA Con apenas 17 años, MAYTE combina dos pasiones: el diseño de indumentaria inspirada en las tradiciones de Tarija y la música, donde fusiona el folclore con sonidos pop. Sus creaciones destacan por los bordados y motivos regionales, plasmados en prendas que combinan la identidad cultural tarijeña con un estilo moderno y elegante, tanto para damas como para varones. Su talento también se expresa a través del canto. La joven artista cuenta con música disponible en plataformas digitales y tuvo la oportunidad de compartir escenario con Los Kjarkas. Mayte presentó sus diseños durante una actividad de promoción de la feria Tarija Produce y también tendrá la oportunidad de mostrar sus creaciones en este espacio. A sus 17 años, apuesta por sus talentos y busca llevar el amor por su tierra a través de la moda y la música. Conocé su historia y escuchá parte de su voz en esta entrevista. Entrevista: Edson Matias #tarija #bolivia #emprendedores #moda #folcloretarijeño | elpais.bo
